The development version adds small, composable features that do not require a
full RPG example. The snippets below belong in a Shiny server function after
`game$set_shiny_session(session)`.

## Save and load

`save_game()` captures live Phaser coordinates in the browser and writes them,
together with arbitrary R state, to JSON on the server. Capturing is
asynchronous, so call it from an observer and do not load the save until the
browser has answered. `load_game()` restores captured objects and returns the R
state.

```r
score <- shiny::reactiveVal(0)

shiny::observeEvent(input$save, {
  game$save_game(
    "quick-save",
    state = list(score = score()),
    objects = "player"
  )
})

shiny::observeEvent(input$load, {
  restored <- game$load_game("quick-save")
  score(restored$score)
})
```

Run the complete, asset-light example with
`shinyphaser::run_save_load_example()`. Saves are server-side: the default
location is a game-specific directory under `tempdir()`. Pass the same explicit
`directory` to save, list, and load when saves must survive R restarts.

## World gravity and a fixed HUD

Gravity is game configuration, while a scroll factor of zero fixes an object to
the camera. These features work for platformers, simulations, and other genres.

```r
game <- PhaserGame$new(gravity_y = 1200)
score_text <- game$add_text("Score: 0", "score", 20, 20)
score_text$set_scroll_factor(0)
```

## Sound

```r
jump <- game$add_sound("jump", "assets/jump.wav", volume = 0.4)
game$add_control(
  "Space",
  browser_action = browser_actions(jump$play()),
  input = input
)
```

## Invisible collision geometry

```r
game$add_collision_rectangle("floor", x = 400, y = 590,
                             width = 800, height = 20)
game$add_collider("player", "floor", input = input)
```

## Switching tilemaps

Use `activate_map()` with only a map key for a simple tilemap switch. Optional
player coordinates and object-visibility vectors are available when an
application needs to perform those transition changes atomically.

```r
game$add_map("level_1", "assets/level-1.json", "assets/tiles.png",
             "tiles", "ground")
game$add_map("level_2", "assets/level-2.json", "assets/tiles.png",
             "tiles", "ground")
game$activate_map("level_2")
```
